name: Eranium Unified Peering
notes:
We are the new-generation connectivity partner, fully privately owned and funded. We have built a next-generation connectivity fabric across major metros like Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Paris, Vienna. [Read more](https://www.eranium.io/about) about our initiative.

We also operate the [ERA-IX](https://www.era-ix.com/) internet exchange platform.

AS44912 is our unified peering product that aggregates and manages peering sessions towards networks like Google, Microsoft, and Cloudflare and is available on our fabric. It's included for free for all ERA-IX members.
